feeds.title: Futsal Focus
feeds.description: Futsal Focus is a media platform for the sport of futsal. A leader in the industry, making historic developments for the sport such as being the first futsal news site validated by Google News and organizing the world's first futsal business conference.

feeds.title: U.S. Futsal News
feeds.description: United States Futsal (USFF) has been governing the sport of Futsal in the United States since 1981. Futsal (Five-a-Side Soccer) is 'The Way the World Plays Indoor Soccer' and is the international form of indoor soccer approved by the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA). It is played in all continents of the world by over 100 countries with 12 million players.

feeds.title: Doug Reed Futsal
feeds.description: My name is Doug Reed and I am a professional futsal player from England. In this blog I will share this love for futsal and provide insights from someone inside the game. I will post entries with my opinions on a variety of topics including youth development, coaching, personal experiences etc. As long as it is related to futsal it could be here!

feeds.title: Futsal Australia News
feeds.description: Federation of Australia Futsal (FAF) is a Not for Profit organisation and the governing body of Futsal in Australia under the membership of Association Mundial de Futsal (AMF) the international governing body for Futsal. Federation of Australia Futsal was established in December 2015 to bring AMF Futsal to Australia and create greater pathways and opportunities for all its members by providing avenues for players and officials to represent Australia in the AMF Tournaments and World Cups ensuring the sport continues to grow in Australia.

feeds.title: Canadian National FUTSAL Association Blog
feeds.description: Canadian National FUTSAL Association (CNFA) is committed to the active promotion of FUTSAL for all Canadians and the development of a safe and welcoming environment for all Canadians participating in the sport of Indoor Soccer - FUTSAL.

feeds.title: FDP Futsal Academy Blog
feeds.description: The FDP Futsal Academy is a unique futsal school that offers a different approach to player development. We give our students the opportunity to experience first-hand what it means to be part of an elite academy, being able to train and play on professional high-quality facilities in games and tournaments against other top-level teams. Our futsal curriculum guides our players through a strong soccer curriculum, designed by professional coaches who have international and national experience at the highest levels of soccer.
